description: A spoken-English coach for Bengali speakers. Speaking practice here is either a BDT 8–24k/month tutor or a Western app that can't hear Bangla-specific mistakes (/v/, /θ/, /æ/), so I built one that can. Azure gives phoneme-level pronunciation scores, a DeepFilterNet3 denoiser microservice cleans the audio first, and for free-speech IELTS turns I transcribe once and feed the transcript back in as the reference. The whole CEFR curriculum (8 chapters, 40 lessons, 7,640 words) was parsed out of the Oxford 3000 PDF, each word with IPA, Bangla meaning and TTS, and SM-2 spaced repetition decides when a word comes back based on how you actually said it. Realtime via Socket.io + Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY, CI/CD to a DigitalOcean droplet.

DL Sprint 4.0 (BUET CSE Fest 2026, hosted on Kaggle): hour-long, noisy Bengali recordings in, who-said-what-when out. Our pipeline runs Demucs vocal separation → VAD → chunked Whisper Medium fine-tuned on Bengali → n-gram repetition cleanup + LLM correction for transcription, and a pyannote segmentation model fine-tuned on the competition data for diarization. Landed WER 0.38 and DER 0.27 on the private leaderboards, and we wrote it up as a paper (arXiv:2603.03158). Team of four with Epshita Jahan, Khandoker Md Tanjinul Islam and Tafsir Al Nafin.

Hackathon backend for BUET CSE Fest 2026, built to survive its own failures. API gateway → order service → inventory service, each with its own Postgres, Kafka in between, deployed to a DigitalOcean box through GitHub Actions. The failure modes are there on purpose: a "Gremlin" middleware delays every Nth request, "ghost" failures commit and then drop the response, and idempotent reservations plus a status check mean retries never double-deduct stock. I wrote 35 of the 58 commits.

A health app that reads your prescriptions and lab reports and actually explains them. Prescription OCR, lab values checked against reference ranges, drug-interaction and symptom agents, and RAG over MedlinePlus + medical textbooks so answers come with sources. Family profiles and a doctor dashboard on top. Team project; I landed 21 merged PRs (about half the commits): the backend, the Python server, the prescription reader, the report analyzer, LLM utils and the Render deploy.

A momentum-based 2D space shooter made for the IUT 12th ICT Fest 2026 GameJam in Unity 6. Ricochet off balls, reflect enemy fire back at them, three levels and a boss. Built in a few days with my teammates as team Expedition 23.

A comprehensive animal welfare platform designed to bridge the gap between pet adoption and community care. The system allows users to report stray animals, browse adoption listings, and manage veterinary records through a secure interface. I focused heavily on the System design and AI orchestration to ensure accessibility for non-technical users while maintaining a robust backend for data integrity. It solves the problem of fragmented pet care information by centralizing it into one responsive application. Built with Khandoker Md Tanjinul Islam, Epshita Jahan, and Rubaiyat Zaman Raisa.

A browser extension designed to automate the workflow of downloading files and staying updated with continuous drive files upload from Google Drive. It detects Drive URLs and downloads the new files in the drive which are not in the local machine, streamlining the experience for power users. I utilized JavaScript DOM manipulation to interact with page elements dynamically. This project highlights my ability to build utility tools that solve specific, repetitive user frustrations.

A centralized academic repository built to help students share and access study materials efficiently. This project tackles the issue of scattered educational resources by providing a structured platform with role-based authentication for admins and students. I architected the application as a decoupled Monorepo, separating the Frontend and Backend to ensure independent scalability and cleaner code maintenance. The system supports file uploads, category filtering, and real-time updates.

A deep dive into Data Engineering concepts, focusing on constructing a Medallion-schema data warehouse. This project involves complex ETL processes to transform raw transactional data into analytical formats suitable for business intelligence. I implemented stored procedures and triggers to automate data integrity checks. It demonstrates my proficiency in handling large datasets and optimizing database architecture for read-heavy operations.

A robust database management practice designed to handle visitor logs and entry tracking for organizations. The project utilizes advanced SQL queries to generate reports on visitor traffic, peak hours, and security alerts. I focused on normalizing the database to 3NF to reduce redundancy and improve query performance. It serves as a practical implementation of relational database theory in a real-world scenario.

An interactive frontend application that leverages AI concepts to help users generate social media content instantly. Also, generates graphs from any written content using mermaid graph format. The interface is built to be minimal yet powerful, allowing users to input prompts and receive formatted posts in real-time. I focused on state management to handle API states (loading, success, error) gracefully, ensuring a smooth user experience. This project represents my step into integrating AI services into modern web UIs.

A classic Online shop built using Java and the JavaFX library, demonstrating core computer networking principles in level 1 term 2. I along with my teammate Khandoker Md Tanjinul Islam, developed a online store to see how things actually work for the online super shops. There we faced race conditions, deadlock and stuffs and gracefully handled each problem with networking

An immersive game development project utilizing the Unity Engine and C# scripting. We designed the gameplay mechanics, including player movement, enemy AI behavior, and level progression systems. The project explores the complexity of Object-Oriented Programming applied to real-time rendering and state management. It showcases my ability to merge creativity with complex logic to build interactive software. Built for the game Soul alongside Ragib Shahrier Bin Kabir and Mohammad Ashfaqul Hasan.

A DevOps utility focused on automating containerization setups for development environments. This repository contains scripts and configurations to instantly spin up Docker containers for various tech stacks, reducing environment inconsistencies. I implemented Docker Compose orchestrations to handle multi-container applications seamlessly. It reflects my focus on developer productivity and infrastructure as code.

A highly reusable starter boilerplate for building scalable backend systems with Node.js. It comes pre-configured with essential security middleware, error handling structures, and API routing best practices. I created this to speed up development cycles for future projects, ensuring a consistent and clean architecture from day one. It demonstrates my proactive approach to software design patterns.
